title: USDC faces bank-rate pressure – Can Visa’s payments push offset it?
summary: Stablecoins face a growth test as bank yields rise, while real-world payment activity creates new opportunities for adoption.
content: USDC faces mounting growth pressure as traditional bank yields rise, presenting a challenge for stablecoin adoption. However, new initiatives by Visa to integrate real-world payments could help offset these pressures by driving broader transaction activity and utility across financial networks.
content_ta: பாரம்பரிய வங்கி வட்டி விகிதங்கள் உயர்வதால் USDC வளர்ச்சிச் சவால்களை எதிர்கொள்கிறது, இது ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் பயன்பாட்டுக்கு ஒரு சோதனையாக அமைந்துள்ளது. எனினும், நிஜ உலகப் பரிவர்த்தனைகளை இணைக்க Visa மேற்கொள்ளும் புதிய முயற்சிகள் இந்த அழுத்தங்களைச் சமாளிக்க உதவும்.

title: Acorns buys Gen Z social finance app Frich
summary: Savings and investment app Acorns has acquired Gen Z-focused social finance app Frich. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
content: Savings and investment app Acorns has announced the acquisition of Frich, a social finance application specifically designed for Generation Z users. The financial terms of the deal were not disclosed by either company. This strategic move allows Acorns to expand its reach and appeal to younger demographics by integrating social financial features into its existing platform.
content_ta: சேமிப்பு மற்றும் முதலீட்டு செயலியான Acorns, Gen Z பயனர்களை இலக்காகக் கொண்ட சோஷியல் ஃபைனான்ஸ் செயலியான Frich-ஐ வாங்கியுள்ளதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. இந்த ஒப்பந்தத்தின் நிதி விவரங்கள் வெளியிடப்படவில்லை. இந்த மூலோபாய நடவடிக்கை Acorns நிறுவனம் இளம் தலைமுறையினரை ஈர்க்கும் வகையில் தனது சேவைகளை விரிவுபடுத்த உதவும்.

title: World takes on AI-driven impersonations with new suite for banking and finance
summary: World, the digital identity project co-founded by OpenAI boss Sam Altman has unveiled suite of tools designed to help banks prevent deepfake fraud and AI-driven impersonation across customer accounts, employee workflows, and agents.
content: World, the digital identity project co-founded by Sam Altman, has introduced a new suite of tools to help the banking and finance sector combat AI-driven impersonation and deepfake fraud. The newly launched security features are designed to protect customer accounts, employee workflows, and digital agents from sophisticated digital identity threats.
content_ta: Sam Altman-ஆல் இணை-நிறுவப்பட்ட டிஜிட்டல் அடையாள திட்டமான World, வங்கி மற்றும் நிதித்துறையில் AI-மூலம் செய்யப்படும் ஆள்மாறாட்டம் மற்றும் டீப்ஃபேக் மோசாடுகளைத் தடுக்க புதிய கருவிகளை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. வாடிக்கையாளர் கணக்குகள் மற்றும் பணியாளர்களின் வேலைப்பாய்வுகளைப் பாதுகாக்க இந்த பாதுகாப்பு அம்சங்கள் வடிவமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன.

title: Meta blames AI tool for mistakenly suspending No Kings Coalition Instagram account
summary:
AI-driven errors in social media moderation can disrupt crucial civic engagement efforts, highlighting the need for transparent oversight.
The post Meta blames AI tool for mistakenly suspending No Kings Coalition Instagram account appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Meta has blamed an artificial intelligence tool for the mistaken suspension of the No Kings Coalition Instagram account. The incident highlights ongoing challenges and errors in automated social media moderation, raising concerns about how algorithmic systems impact civic engagement and online visibility for political and activist groups.
content_ta: No Kings Coalition இன் Instagram கணக்கு தவறாக முடக்கப்பட்டதற்கு ஒரு AI கருவியே காரணம் என்று Meta நிறுவனம் தெரிவித்துள்ளது. சமூக வலைதளங்களில் தானியங்கி முறையில் செய்யப்படும் தணிக்கைகளில் ஏற்படும் இதுபோன்ற பிழைகள், பொதுமக்களின் ஈடுபாட்டையும் கருத்துரிமையையும் எவ்வாறு பாதிக்கின்றன என்ற கவலையை இந்தச் சம்பவம் ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds
summary: Qubic says 87.1% of the stolen funds remain onchain and the rest were frozen at crypto exchange MEXC, as network validators prepare to vote on a recovery plan.
content: Qubic halted its blockchain after an attacker compromised over a thousand wallets using weak seeds. The network reported that a significant portion of the stolen funds remains on the blockchain, while some assets were successfully frozen at the MEXC cryptocurrency exchange. Network validators are currently preparing to vote on a comprehensive recovery plan to address the security breach.
content_ta: பலவீனமான சீட்களை பயன்படுத்தி ஆயிரத்திற்கும் மேற்பட்ட வாலட்டுகளில் இருந்து ஹேக்கர் திருடியதை தொடர்ந்து Qubic தனது பிளாக்செயினை தற்காலிகமாக முடக்கியது. திருடப்பட்ட நிதியில் பெரும்பகுதி பிளாக்செயினில் அப்படியே இருப்பதாகவும், சில சொத்துக்கள் MEXC கிரிப்டோ பரிமாற்றத்தில் முடக்கப்பட்டதாகவும் நெட்வொர்க் தெரிவித்துள்ளது. இந்த பாதுகாப்பு மீறல் தொடர்பான மீட்புத் திட்டம் குறித்து வாக்களிக்க நெட்வொர்க் வேலிடேட்டர்கள் தயாராகி வருகின்றனர்.

title: World launches World ID suite for banks, makes Zoom deepfake check generally available
summary:
The integration of World ID tools in banking and Zoom could enhance security and privacy, potentially reshaping digital identity verification.
The post World launches ID suite for banks, makes Zoom deepfake check generally available appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: World has launched a new World ID suite designed for banks and made its Zoom deepfake detection tool generally available. These integrations aim to improve digital identity verification, enhancing security and privacy across financial services and video communication platforms.
content_ta: World நிறுவனம் வங்கிகளுக்காக புதிய World ID தொகுப்பை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளதுடன், Zoom மீதான டீப்ஃபேக் கண்டறிதல் கருவியையும் பொதுப் பயன்பாட்டிற்குக் கொண்டு வந்துள்ளது. இந்த ஒருங்கிணைப்புகள் டிஜிட்டல் அடையாள சரிபார்ப்பை மேம்படுத்தி, நிதி சேவைகள் மற்றும் வீடியோ தொடர்பு தளங்களில் பாதுகாப்பை அதிகரிக்க உதவும்.

title: Algorand tops post-quantum race with 2.7M secure transfers- Will it rally ALGO?
summary: Algorand still does not have a full post-quantum security across its entire stack
content: Recent reports suggest Algorand is leading in the post-quantum race with millions of secure transfers, sparking questions about whether the ALGO token will rally. However, research clarifies that Algorand still does not feature full post-quantum security across its entire technology stack, highlighting ongoing challenges in achieving complete quantum resistance for the network.
content_ta: போஸ்ட்-குவாண்டம் பந்தயத்தில் மில்லியன் கணக்கான பாதுகாப்பான பரிமாற்றங்களுடன் Algorand முன்னணியில் இருப்பதாக சமீபத்திய அறிக்கைகள் தெரிவிக்கின்றன, இது ALGO டோக்கன் மீண்டு வருமா என்ற கேள்விகளை எழுப்பியுள்ளது. இருப்பினும், Algorand இன் முழு ஸ்டாக்கிலும் இன்னும் முழுமையான போஸ்ட்-குவாண்டம் பாதுகாப்பு இல்லை என்று ஆராய்ச்சி தெளிவுபடுத்துகிறது.

title: Black Monday Fears Fade as Nasdaq Futures Rally After Friday Selloff
summary:
Nasdaq 100 futures rose about 0.9% early Monday, defying Black Monday calls after Friday's chip-led Wall Street selloff.
The post Black Monday Fears Fade as Nasdaq Futures Rally After Friday Selloff appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Nasdaq 100 futures rebounded by approximately 0.9 percent during early Monday trading, helping to ease widespread fears of a severe market crash following Friday's significant chip-led selloff on Wall Street. Despite earlier concerns and warnings of a potential Black Monday event, major stock index futures showed positive momentum as the trading week began.
content_ta: வெள்ளிக்கிழமை Wall Street சந்தையில் ஏற்பட்ட சரிவுக்குப் பிறகு, திங்கட்கிழமை தொடக்க வர்த்தகத்தில் Nasdaq 100 ஃபியூச்சர்ஸ் சுமார் 0.9 சதவீதம் உயர்ந்தது. இதனால் Black Monday குறித்த அச்சம் தணிந்துள்ளது. சந்தை சரிவு குறித்த எச்சரிக்கைகள் இருந்தபோதிலும், வர்த்தக வாரம் தொடங்கியபோது முக்கிய பங்கு குறியீட்டு ஃபியூச்சர்ஸ் நேர்மறையான போக்கைக் காட்டியது.

title: Egypt approves troop deployment in support of Saudi Arabia
summary:
Egypt's troop deployment may strengthen Saudi defenses, potentially deterring Houthi advances and impacting regional military dynamics.
The post Egypt approves troop deployment in support of Saudi Arabia appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Egypt has officially approved a troop deployment to support Saudi Arabia. This military move is expected to strengthen Saudi defenses and could potentially deter Houthi advances. The deployment is likely to have a significant impact on regional military dynamics and strategic alliances in the area, according to reports.
content_ta: Saudi Arabia-வை ஆதரிக்கும் வகையில் ராணுவ வீரர்களை அனுப்புவதற்கு Egypt ஒப்புதல் அளித்துள்ளது. இந்த ராணுவ நடவடிக்கை Saudi Arabia-வின் பாதுகாப்பை பலப்படுத்தும் என்றும், Houthi-களின் முன்னேற்றத்தைத் தடுக்கக்கூடும் என்றும் எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது. இந்த நகர்வு பிராந்திய ராணுவ சூழலிலும் கூட்டணிகளிலும் பெரிய தாக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்தும்.

title: BlackRock pushes deeper into tokenization with funds, portfolios and stablecoin reserves
summary:
BlackRock's tokenization efforts could revolutionize financial markets by enhancing transparency, efficiency, and accessibility globally.
The post BlackRock pushes deeper into tokenization with funds, portfolios and stablecoin reserves appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Asset management giant BlackRock is expanding its focus on tokenization by integrating digital assets into its funds, investment portfolios, and stablecoin reserves. This move highlights the growing adoption of blockchain technology within traditional finance, aiming to improve market transparency, efficiency, and accessibility.
content_ta: சொத்து மேலாண்மை நிறுவனமான BlackRock, தனது நிதிகள், முதலீட்டுப் போர்ட்ஃபோலியோக்கள் மற்றும் ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் இருப்புகளில் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்களை இணைப்பதன் மூலம் டோக்கனைசேஷன் துறையில் தனது ஈடுபாட்டை விரிவுபடுத்துகிறது. இந்த நடவடிக்கை பாரம்பரிய நிதியமைப்பில் பிளாக்செயின் தொழில்நுட்பத்தின் வளர்ந்து வரும் பயன்பாட்டை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

title: South Korean stocks slide as DeepSeek model stokes memory chip demand fears
summary:
The emergence of efficient AI models could reshape memory chip pricing and market dynamics, challenging South Korean chipmakers' dominance.
The post South Korean stocks slide as DeepSeek model stokes memory chip demand fears appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: South Korean stocks experienced a notable decline following market concerns that the rise of the DeepSeek model could disrupt memory chip demand. The emergence of these efficient artificial intelligence models raises questions about future pricing and market dynamics, posing potential challenges to the traditional dominance of South Korean chipmakers in the global semiconductor industry.
content_ta: DeepSeek மாடலின் வருகை மெமரி சிப் தேவையில் தாக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்தக்கூடும் என்ற அச்சத்தால் தென் கொரிய பங்குச் சந்தை வீழ்ச்சியடைந்தது. திறமையான செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு மாடல்களின் வளர்ச்சி சிப் விலைகள் மற்றும் சந்தை நிலவரங்களை மாற்றி, தென் கொரிய சிப் தயாரிப்பாளர்களின் ஆதிக்கத்திற்கு சவாலாக அமையலாம்.

title: First Digital to List on Nasdaq via SPAC Deal at $250m Valuation
summary:
The FDUSD stablecoin issuer has signed a business combination agreement with KOYN to go public, targeting a first-half 2027 close.
The post First Digital to List on Nasdaq via SPAC Deal at $250m Valuation appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: First Digital, the issuer of the FDUSD stablecoin, has signed an agreement with KOYN to list on Nasdaq through a SPAC deal. The transaction values the company at $250 million. The companies expect the business combination to close in the first half of 2027.
content_ta: FDUSD stablecoin-ஐ வெளியிடும் First Digital நிறுவனம், SPAC ஒப்பந்தம் மூலம் Nasdaq-ல் பட்டியலிட KOYN உடன் ஒரு ஒப்பந்தத்தில் கையெழுத்திட்டுள்ளது. இந்த ஒப்பந்தத்தின் மூலம் நிறுவனத்தின் மதிப்பு $250 மில்லியனாக மதிப்பிடப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த வணிக இணைப்பானது 2027-ஆம் ஆண்டின் முதல் பாதியில் நிறைவடையும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: SUI has rewards, buybacks, and a new CEO – What’s still missing is…
summary: How a new CEO, Robinhood reward campaign and buybacks could help SUI reverse.
content: SUI is experiencing notable developments, including the introduction of a new CEO, a Robinhood reward campaign, and buybacks. These strategic moves aim to boost the asset and help it reverse its recent market trends. However, market observers note that despite these positive catalysts, certain elements may still be missing for a full recovery.
content_ta: SUI-ல் புதிய CEO நியமனம், Robinhood ரிவார்டு பிரச்சாரம் மற்றும் பைபேக்குகள் உள்ளிட்ட குறிப்பிடத்தக்க முன்னேற்றங்கள் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளன. இந்த மூலோபாய நகர்வுகள் சொத்தின் மதிப்பை உயர்த்துவதையும், அதன் சந்தை போக்குகளை மாற்றியமைப்பதையும் நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளன. இருப்பினும், முழுமையான மீட்சிக்கு சில அம்சங்கள் இன்னும் விடுபட்டிருக்கலாம் என்று சந்தை பார்வையாளர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: CXMT Shares Fall 6.5% After US Selloff and Despite Profit Turnaround
summary:
CXMT shares fell 6.5% Monday as the US chip selloff spread to Asia, overshadowing the memory maker's profit turnaround.
The post CXMT Shares Fall 6.5% After US Selloff and Despite Profit Turnaround appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: CXMT shares dropped 6.5% on Monday following a broader US chip selloff that spread to Asian markets. The decline overshadowed the memory maker's recent profit turnaround. The downturn reflects global market pressures affecting technology stocks despite the company's positive financial progress.
content_ta: அமெரிக்காவில் தொடங்கிய சிப் பங்குகளின் சரிவு ஆசிய சந்தைகளுக்கும் பரவியதால், திங்களன்று CXMT-ன் பங்குகள் 6.5% சரிந்தன. இந்த சரிவு, அந்த நிறுவனத்தின் லாப மீட்சியைப் பின்னுக்குத் தள்ளியது. நிறுவனத்தின் நிதி நிலை மேம்பட்டிருந்த போதிலும், உலகளாவிய சந்தை அழுத்தங்கள் தொழில்நுட்பப் பங்குகளைப் பாதித்துள்ளன.

title: Fed Hike Before December? Ben Emons Says Data, Not Midterms, Decides
summary:
Ben Emons says a Fed hike is underpriced and that data, not the midterms, will decide whether the Fed moves by December.
The post Fed Hike Before December? Ben Emons Says Data, Not Midterms, Decides appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Analyst Ben Emons suggests that market pricing for a Federal Reserve rate hike before December may be underestimated. According to Emons, upcoming economic data will be the primary driver for central bank decisions, rather than the upcoming midterm elections.

title: Zcash developers plan a fix to keep ZEC swaps private from future quantum computers
summary: The team behind Zakura wants every swap through NEAR Intents to get its own key, so a refund address left on NEAR’s public chain can’t expose a user’s wider payment history.
content: Developers behind Zcash are planning a fix to protect ZEC swaps from potential future quantum computers. The team wants every transaction through NEAR Intents to use its own unique key, ensuring that refund addresses left on the public chain cannot expose a user's wider payment history and private data.
content_ta: எதிர்கால குவாண்டம் கம்ப்யூட்டர்களிட1ருந்து ZEC பரிமாற்றங்களைப் பாதுகாக்க Zcash டெவலப்பர்கள் திட்டமிட்டுள்ளனர். NEAR Intents மூலம் நடக்கும் ஒவ்வொரு பரிமாற்றமும் தனித்துவமான கீ-யைப் பயன்படுத்த வேண்டும் என்று குழு விரும்புகிறது. இதன் மூலம் பொதுவான செயினில் விடப்படும் ரீஃபண்ட் முகவரியானது பயனரின் பரந்த கட்டண வரலாற்றை வெளிப்படுத்தாமல் பாதுகாக்கும்.

title: Updation Integrates With U.S. Bank to Help Dealerships Modernize Payments and Financial Operations
summary:
U.S. Bank and Updation, an AI-powered accounts payable, vendor management and contract management platform built for automotive dealerships, today announced a collaboration to help dealers streamline financial operations and manage payments more efficiently. Updation serves automotive, truck, RV and powersports dealerships, helping them automate invoice processing, improve visibility into spending and reduce manual administrative work.
As part of the collaboration, Updation will leverage U.S. Bank Embedded Payment Solutions, including a for-benefit-of (FBO) account structure. The structure allows funds to be securely held and moved through a bank-managed framework, helping dealerships benefit from stronger controls and reducing the need for Updation to directly handle customer funds. The combined solution allows dealerships to better manage invoices, vendor relationships and payments from a unified environment while benefiting from bank-led payment infrastructure and greater transparency into the movement of funds.
“We built Updation to help dealerships gain better control over their financial operations and spend less time on manual processes,” said Layton Judd, chief executive officer of Updation. “Working with U.S. Bank allows us to bring AI-powered accounting intelligence, workflow and payments together in one platform, backed by trusted banking and payment infrastructure. Together, we’re giving dealerships better visibility into their financial operations while making the movement of money faster, easier and more secure.”
“Dealerships are looking for ways to reduce manual processes and improve visibility into their finances," said Joe Voica, head of embedded payments at U.S. Bank. summary: Nasdaq 100 futures climbed nearly 1% early Monday, challenging social media predictions that markets would open into a "Black Monday" crash.
content: Despite social media predictions of a major market crash on Monday, financial analysts have dismissed the panic surrounding Bitcoin. Market indicators show a healthy breakout and retest pattern, suggesting everything is fine. Meanwhile, Nasdaq 100 futures also rose nearly 1% early Monday, countering fears of a severe downturn and bringing stability back to investor sentiment.
content_ta: திங்கட்கிழமை சந்தையில் பெரும் சரிவு ஏற்படும் என்ற சமூக வலைதளங்களின் கணிப்புகளை நிபுணர்கள் நிராகரித்துள்ளனர். Bitcoin-ன் தற்போதைய நிலவரப்படி சந்தை ஆரோக்கியமான நிலையில் உள்ளது தெளிவாகிறது. இதற்கிடையில், திங்கட்கிழமை தொடக்கத்தில் Nasdaq 100 ஃபியூச்சர்ஸ் கிட்டத்தட்ட 1% உயர்ந்து, கடுமையான வீழ்ச்சி குறித்த அச்சத்தைப் போக்கியுள்ளதுடன் முதலீட்டாளர்கள் மத்தியில் ஸ்திரத்தன்மையை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: Ripple’s institutional bet: XRPL moves beyond payments and into tokenized finance
summary: Measurable on-chain demand will determine whether Ripple’s expansion delivers lasting adoption.
content: Ripple is expanding the XRP Ledger beyond traditional payments into the growing sector of tokenized finance. This strategic shift aims to capture institutional interest and bring real-world assets onto the blockchain. However, analysts note that measurable on-chain demand will ultimately determine whether this ambitious expansion achieves lasting adoption in the broader financial market.
content_ta: Ripple நிறுவனம் தனது XRP Ledger-ஐ பாரம்பரிய பணப் பரிமாற்றங்களை தாண்டி, டோக்கன் செய்யப்பட்ட நிதித்துறைக்குள் விரிவுபடுத்துகிறது. நிறுவனங்களின் முதலீட்டை ஈர்ப்பதே இந்த வியூக மாற்றத்தின் நோக்கமாகும். இருப்பினும், பிளாக்சைன் தொழில்நுட்பத்தில் உண்மையான தேவை இருக்கிறதா என்பதுதான் இந்த விரிவாக்கம் நீண்டகால வெற்றியைப் பெறுமா என்பதைத் தீர்மானிக்கும் என்று ஆய்வாளர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: Bitcoin defies Black Monday fears, shows signs of November 2024’s rally
summary: Bitcoin’s resilience amid Black Monday panic puts BTC dominance in focus.
content: Bitcoin has shown strong resilience by defying recent Black Monday market fears. This unexpected stability and recovery have highlighted signs reminiscent of the notable November 2024 rally, bringing renewed attention and focus to Bitcoin dominance across the broader financial markets.
content_ta: Bitcoin சமீபத்திய பிளாக் மண்டே (Black Monday) சந்தை அச்சங்களை எதிர்கொண்டு வலுவான மீட்சி கண்டுள்ளது. இந்த எதிர்பாராத ஸ்திரத்தன்மை கடந்த November 2024 பேரணியை நினைவுபடுத்துவதுடன், பரந்த நிதிச் சந்தைகளில் Bitcoin ஆதிக்கத்திற்கு புதிய கவனத்தை ஈர்த்துள்ளது.

content: MKI Global Partners, an independent advisory firm focusing on complex situations, has expanded its operations by establishing an emerging markets practice. The firm's new practice will initially focus on Latin America, aiming to provide specialized advisory services to clients operating in or expanding into the region.
content_ta: சிக்கலான சூழ்நிலைகளில் நிபுணத்துவம் பெற்ற சுயாதீன ஆலோசனை நிறுவனமான MKI Global Partners, வளரும் சந்தைப் பிரிவை உருவாக்குவதன் மூலம் தனது சேவைகளை விரிவுபடுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த புதிய பிரிவு ஆரம்பத்தில் Latin America-வை மையமாகக் கொண்டு செயல்படும்.

title: PingPong partners with Getnet for LatAm expansion
summary: PingPong, the intelligent payments infrastructure for global growth, today announces a strategic partnership with Getnet, the leading AI-payments company, part of Santander Group, to expand access to its financial infrastructure across Iberia.
content: PingPong, an intelligent payments infrastructure provider, has announced a strategic partnership with Getnet, an AI-payments company under Santander Group. This collaboration aims to expand the reach of PingPong's financial infrastructure into Iberia, marking a significant step in the companies' regional growth and market integration.
content_ta: சர்வதேச அளவில் நிதி சேவைகளை வழங்கி வரும் PingPong நிறுவனம், Santander குழுமத்தைச் சேர்ந்த செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு அடிப்படையிலான கட்டண நிறுவனமான Getnet உடன் ஒரு முக்கிய மூலோபாய கூட்டாண்மையை அறிவித்துள்ளது. இபெரியா பகுதியில் PingPong-இன் நிதி உள்கட்டமைப்பை விரிவுபடுத்துவதை இந்த ஒத்துழைப்பு நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.

title: PayMore to launch on Google Play
summary: PayMore (paymore.io), the consumer mobile app that gives GCC users prepaid virtual cards for online shopping, subscriptions and digital services, today announced that its Android app is launching soon on Google Play.
content: PayMore, the consumer mobile application providing prepaid virtual cards for online shopping, subscriptions, and digital services to users in the GCC region, has announced the upcoming launch of its Android application on Google Play. The app is designed to make digital transactions more accessible for consumers in the area.
content_ta: GCC பகுதி பயனர்களுக்கு ஆன்லைன் ஷாப்பிங், சந்தாக்கள் மற்றும் டிஜிட்டல் சேவைகளுக்காக ப்ரீபெய்ட் விர்ச்சுவல் கார்டுகளை வழங்கும் PayMore செயலியின் Android பதிப்பு விரைவில் Google Play-ல் வெளியாகவுள்ளதாக அறிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Live updates: Bitcoin tags $83,000 and slips back as chip stocks lead market rebound
summary: Tech futures bounced after last week’s 5.5% rout, and bitcoin followed them up before sellers knocked it back. Earnings this week put the AI trade to the test again.
content: Tech futures rebounded following last week's market rout, lifting major indices. Meanwhile, cryptocurrency Bitcoin surged to reach $83,000 before experiencing a pullback as sellers entered the market. Investor attention now turns to upcoming earnings reports, which are expected to test the artificial intelligence trade and provide further direction for global markets.
content_ta: கடந்த வார சந்தை சரிவுக்குப் பிறகு தொழில்நுட்ப பியூச்சர்ஸ் மீண்டு வந்துள்ளன. இதற்கிடையில், விற்பனையாளர்களின் அழுத்தத்தால் பின்வாங்குவதற்கு முன்பு, கிரிப்டோகரன்சியான Bitcoin $83,000 விலையை எட்டியது. AI வர்த்தகத்தை மீண்டும் சோதிக்கும் வகையில் இந்த வாரத்தின் வருவாய் அறிக்கைகள் வெளியாகும் என்பதால், முதலீட்டாளர்களின் கவனம் அந்தப் பக்கம் திரும்பியுள்ளது.

title: World Liberty’s USD1 stablecoin sheds $400M in market cap in two weeks
summary: World Liberty Financial’s USD1 stablecoin saw its market cap decrease more than $400 million over two weeks of large redemptions on Ethereum and BNB Chain.
content: World Liberty Financial's USD1 stablecoin has experienced a significant drop in its market capitalization, shedding more than $400 million over a two-week period. This decline was driven by large redemptions occurring across both the Ethereum and BNB Chain networks, reflecting ongoing shifts and liquidity challenges for the digital asset.
content_ta: World Liberty Financial-ன் USD1 stablecoin அதன் market cap-ல் கடந்த இரண்டு வாரங்களில் 400 மில்லியன் டாலருக்கும் அதிகமான வீழ்ச்சியை சந்தித்துள்ளது. Ethereum மற்றும் BNB Chain நெட்வொர்க்குகளில் நடந்த பெரிய அளவிலான மீட்புகளே (redemptions) இந்த சரித்திற்குக் காரணம் ஆகும்.

title: Sam Altman's World Takes Proof-of-Human IDs to Banks, Citing $40B AI Fraud Risk
summary: Bain Capital, VanEck and Pantera Capital are among design partners for the offering, which also lets users delegate proofs to AI agents.
content: Sam Altman's World is expanding its proof-of-human identity system to banks, citing a massive $40 billion fraud risk driven by artificial intelligence. Firms such as Bain Capital, VanEck, and Pantera Capital are participating as design partners. The new offering aims to verify human identity and also allows users to delegate proofs to AI agents.
content_ta: AI-னால் ஏற்படும் 40 பில்லியன் டாலர் மோசடி அபாயத்தைக் சுட்டிக்காட்டி, Sam Altman-ன் World நிறுவனம் தனது proof-of-human அடையாள அமைப்பை வங்கிகளுக்கு விரிவுபடுத்துகிறது. Bain Capital, VanEck மற்றும் Pantera Capital போன்ற நிறுவனங்கள் இதன் வடிவமைப்பு பங்காளிகளாக உள்ளன. மனித அடையாளத்தைச் சரிபார்ப்பதுடன், பயனர்கள் AI agents-களுக்கு proofs-ஐ வழங்கவும் இந்த புதிய offering அனுமதிக்கிறது.

title: UK Trio Jailed Over Home Invasion in Failed Crypto Theft Attempt
summary: The victim was hit over the head before his teenage sister alerted police, who arrested all three men at the scene in May.
content: Three men in the UK have been jailed for carrying out a violent home invasion in a failed attempt to steal cryptocurrency. The victim was struck on the head during the attack before his teenage sister alerted the police. Officers arrived at the scene in May and successfully arrested all three suspects.
content_ta: UK-ல் cryptocurrency-ஐத் திருட முயன்று தோல்வியடைந்த ஒரு வழக்கில், வீட்டிற்குள் அத்துமீறி நுழைந்து தாக்குதல் நடத்திய மூன்று பேருக்குச் சிறைத் தண்டனை விதிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்தத் தாக்குதலின் போது பாதிக்கப்பட்டவர் தலையில் தாக்கப்பட்டார், பின்னர் அவரது டீன் ஏஜ் தங்கை காவல்துறையினருக்குத் தகவல் தெரிவித்தார். மே மாதத்தில் சம்பவ இடத்திற்கு வந்த அதிகாரிகள் மூன்று சந்தேக நபர்களையும் கைது செய்தனர்.

title: Revolut secures Gibraltar crypto licence to support international expansion plans
summary: Revolut secured a Gibraltar DLT licence for a new entity to support its international crypto expansion strategy.
content: Digital banking giant Revolut has secured a distributed ledger technology (DLT) licence in Gibraltar. This regulatory approval will allow the company to establish a new entity designed to support its ambitious international cryptocurrency expansion strategy and broaden its digital asset services to global customers.
content_ta: டிஜிட்டல் வங்கி நிறுவனமான Revolut, Gibraltar-ல் distributed ledger technology (DLT) உரிமத்தைப் பெற்றுள்ளது. இந்த ஒழுங்குமுறை ஒப்புதல், அதன் சர்வதேச cryptocurrency விரிவாக்க உத்தியை ஆதரிக்கவும், உலகளாவிய வாடிக்கையாளர்களுக்கு தனது டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து சேவைகளை விரிவுபடுத்தவும் ஒரு புதிய நிறுவனத்தை உருவாக்க வழிவகுக்கும்.

title: XRP holders can now earn fees from Kraken’s DeFi customers, but there is a catch
summary:
Sentora’s Firelight coverage pays premiums from vault yield, while FXRP providers’ shared backing can absorb validated losses after a stablecoin buffer.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: XRP holders can now earn fees from Kraken's DeFi customers through new coverage and vault yield mechanisms. However, there are specific conditions involved, as Sentora's Firelight coverage pays premiums from vault yield while FXRP providers share backing to absorb validated losses after a stablecoin buffer.
content_ta: XRP holders இப்போது Kraken-ன் DeFi வாடிக்கையாளர்களிடம் இருந்து புதிய கவரேஜ் மற்றும் வால்ட் ஈல்டு மெக்கானிசம் மூலம் கட்டணங்களை ஈட்ட முடியும். இருப்பினும், இதில் சில குறிப்பிட்ட நிபந்தனைகள் உள்ளன, ஏனெனில் Sentora-ன் Firelight கவரேஜ் வால்ட் ஈல்டில் இருந்து பிரீமியங்களைச் செலுத்துகிறது, அதே நேரத்தில் FXRP வழங்குநர்கள் ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் பஃபருக்குப் பிறகு அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்ட இழப்புகளை உறிஞ்ச கூட்டாக ஆதரவளிக்கின்றனர்.

title: Ethereum Price Prediction: JPMorgan Brings Wall Street Closer to ETH
summary:
JPMorgan’s Ethereum deposit-token launch adds an institutional use case as ETH tests resistance near $2,448 and traders watch $2,600.
The post Ethereum Price Prediction: JPMorgan Brings Wall Street Closer to ETH appeared first on Cryptonews.
content: JPMorgan has launched an Ethereum deposit-token, which introduces a new institutional use case for the cryptocurrency. Meanwhile, traders are closely monitoring ETH price movements as it tests resistance near $2,448, with many looking ahead to the $2,600 level. This development marks a significant step in bringing traditional Wall Street interest closer to the Ethereum ecosystem.
content_ta: JPMorgan நிறுவனம் ETH டெபாசிட்-டோக்கனை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது, இது கிரிப்டோகரன்சிக்கு நிறுவன அளவிலான புதிய பயன்பாட்டை உருவாக்குகிறது. இதற்கிடையில், ETH விலை $2,448 அருகில் உள்ள எதிர்ப்பைச் சோதித்து வருவதால் வர்த்தகர்கள் உன்னிப்பாகக் கவனித்து வருகின்றனர், மேலும் பலர் $2,600 அளவை எதிர்பார்த்துக் காத்திருக்கின்றனர். இந்த வளர்ச்சி பாரம்பரிய Wall Street ஆர்வம் Ethereum சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்புடன் நெருங்கி வருவதற்கான ஒரு முக்கியமான படியைக் குறிக்கிறது.

title: Qubic hit by major exploit – 87.1% of stolen funds frozen within hours
summary: Qubic has frozen most stolen funds and patched the wallet flaw, but restitution and a full network restart remain unresolved.
content: Qubic has suffered a major exploit, resulting in the theft of funds. However, the team successfully froze 87.1 percent of the stolen assets within hours of the incident and patched the underlying wallet flaw. Despite this swift action, the process for user restitution and a full network restart remains unresolved as the investigation continues.
content_ta: Qubic-ல் ஏற்பட்ட ஒரு பெரிய சைபர் தாக்குதலால் நிதி திருடப்பட்டுள்ளது. இருப்பினும், தாக்குதல் நடந்த சில மணி நேரங்களுக்குள் திருடப்பட்ட நிதியில் 87.1 சதவீதத்தை குழுவினர் வெற்றிகரமாக முடக்கியுள்ளனர் மற்றும் வாலட்டில் இருந்த குறைபாட்டையும் சரி செய்துள்ளனர். இந்த விரைவான நடவடிக்க w இருந்தாலும், பயனர்களுக்கு இழப்பீடு வழங்குவது மற்றும் முழுமையான நெட்வொர்க்கை மீண்டும் தொடங்குவது தொடர்பான விஷயங்கள் இன்னும் முடிவு செய்யப்படவில்லை.

title: ZEC tops $1,171 as quantum-proofing work speeds up – Inside Zakura’s proposal
summary: Zakura proposed using a private key for every ZEC swap via NEAR Intents.
content: ZEC recently climbed above $1,171 as development work on quantum-proofing accelerates. This upward momentum follows Zakura's proposal to utilize a private key for every ZEC swap through NEAR Intents, highlighting ongoing security enhancements and growing interest in the network's future capabilities amid shifting industry standards.
content_ta: ZEC இன் மதிப்பு $1,171-ஐத் தாண்டி உயர்ந்தது. குவாண்டம்-ப்ரூஃபிங் பணிகள் விரைவுபடுத்தப்பட்டு வரும் நிலையில் இந்த விலை உயர்வு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது. NEAR Intents மூலம் ஒவ்வொரு ZEC பரிமாற்றத்திற்கும் தனிப்பட்ட பிரைவேட் கீ-யைப் பயன்படுத்த வேண்டும் என்ற Zakura-வின் முன்மொழிவு இதற்கு முக்கியக் காரணமாகும்.

title: CZ Says Peter Schiff Will Be Right About Bitcoin One Day. There’s a Catch
summary:
Binance founder CZ mocks a supercut of Peter Schiff Bitcoin doom calls spanning 13 years. See the punchline Schiff delivers in the final clip.
The post CZ Says Peter Schiff Will Be Right About Bitcoin One Day. There’s a Catch appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Binance founder CZ recently reacted to a retrospective video compiling 13 years of Peter Schiff predicting the doom of Bitcoin. CZ remarked that Schiff will indeed be right about Bitcoin one day, but added a clever punchline at the very end of the clip, playfully highlighting Schiff's long-running skepticism toward the cryptocurrency.
content_ta: Binance நிறுவனத்தின் நிறுவனர் CZ, Peter Schiff கடந்த 13 ஆண்டுகளாக Bitcoin குறித்து கூறிய எதிர்மறையான கருத்துகளின் தொகுப்பு வீடியோவிற்கு பதிலளித்துள்ளார். Bitcoin பற்றி Schiff ஒரு நாள் சரியாகச் சொல்வார் என்று குறிப்பிட்ட CZ, அந்த வீடியோவின் இறுதியில் உள்ள ஒரு குறும்புத்தனமான வரியையும் சுட்டிக்காட்டினார்.

title: France tightens security, pledges aid after violent cost-of-living protests
summary:
The government's response to protests may lead to increased civil restrictions, impacting public freedoms and economic stability in France.
The post France tightens security, pledges aid after violent cost-of-living protests appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: France has responded to violent cost-of-living protests by tightening security measures and pledging financial aid. The government's actions aim to restore order, though concerns have been raised regarding potential impacts on public freedoms and overall economic stability in the region.
content_ta: வாழ்க்கைச் செலவு அதிகரிப்புக்கு எதிரான வன்முறைப் போராட்டங்களை அடுத்து, பிரான்ஸ் அரசு பாதுகாப்பை பலப்படுத்தியுள்ளதுடன் நிதி உதவியையும் அறிவித்துள்ளது. பொதுச் சுதந்திரம் மற்றும் பொருளாதார ஸ்திரத்தன்மை பாதிக்கப்படலாம் என்ற கவலைகளுக்கு மத்தியில் இந்த நடவடிக்கைகள் எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன.

title: Microsoft cancels AI data center in Essex over power supply concerns
summary:
The cancellation underscores the critical need for reliable energy solutions in tech infrastructure, potentially influencing global data center strategies.
The post Microsoft cancels AI data center in Essex over power supply concerns appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Microsoft has cancelled plans to build a new AI data center in Essex due to ongoing power supply concerns. This decision highlights the growing infrastructure challenges faced by major technology companies as they struggle to secure reliable energy for large-scale operations, which could impact future global deployment strategies.
content_ta: Essex-ல் திட்டமிடப்பட்டிருந்த புதிய AI data center திட்டத்தை மின் விநியோக பற்றாக்குறை காரணமாக Microsoft ரத்து செய்துள்ளது. பெரிய தொழில்நுட்ப நிறுவனங்கள் தங்களின் எதிர்கால திட்டங்களுக்கு நம்பகமான ஆற்றலைப் பெறுவதில் எதிர்கொள்ளும் சவால்களை இந்த முடிவு வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது.

title: Houthi strikes hit Saudi Arabia, pressure mounts on MBS to bolster defenses
summary:

title: 6th FinTech Week & Expo to Take Place in Paris on 4–5 May 2027, Exploring the Future of European Finance
summary:
The People Events is pleased to announce the 6th FinTech Week & Expo, taking place on 4–5 May 2027 in Paris, France. Under the theme “The Future of European Finance: AI, Instant Payments & Digital Trust,” the two-day event will bring together professionals from banking, financial services, fintech, payments, cybersecurity, regulatory technology and the wider technology ecosystem.
Building on the success of the previous edition in Frankfurt, Germany, which welcomed more than 400 attendees, the Paris edition will provide a platform for industry leaders, decision-makers, innovators and technology providers to exchange insights, explore emerging opportunities and develop meaningful business relationships.
As Europe’s financial services landscape continues to evolve, the event will focus on the technologies, regulations and partnerships shaping the future of finance, with particular emphasis on artificial intelligence, instant payments, digital identity, cybersecurity and trusted financial infrastructure.
The Future of European Finance: AI, Instant Payments & Digital Trust
The financial services industry is experiencing rapid transformation as artificial intelligence reshapes operations, instant payments change the movement of money, and digital trust becomes increasingly important to customers, businesses and regulators.
The 6th FinTech Week & Expo will explore how financial institutions and technology providers can navigate these developments, strengthen resilience, improve customer experiences and unlock new opportunities for innovation.
Key topics will include:
Artificial Intelligence in Financial Services: Exploring AI-driven transformation, intelligent automation, responsible AI adoption, governance and risk management.
Instant Payments and Next-Generation Payment Infrastructure: Examining real-time payments, account-to-account transactions, cross-border payments and the evolution of European payment systems.
Digital Trust, Identity and Cybersecurity: Addressing digital identity verification, authentication, deepfakes, zero-trust security and the protection of financial ecosystems.
Financial Crime Prevention and Regulatory Technology: Discussing AML, KYC, fraud detection, transaction monitoring and technology-enabled compliance.
Open Finance and Embedded Finance: Exploring connected financial services, data-driven innovation and new opportunities for collaboration.
European Financial Regulation and Resilience: Examining regulatory developments, operational resilience and the changing compliance landscape for financial institutions.
Digital Assets and the Future of Money: Exploring tokenisation, stablecoins, central bank digital currencies and emerging financial infrastructure.
Through keynote presentations, expert-led panel discussions, industry insights and networking opportunities, the event will encourage practical conversations about how innovation can support a more connected, secure and competitive European financial ecosystem.
Building on the Success of the Previous Edition
The previous edition of FinTech Week & Expo in Frankfurt welcomed 400+ attendees, bringing together a diverse community of financial services professionals, fintech companies, technology innovators, corporate delegates, speakers and industry partners.
The event received support from leading organisations across digital identity, consulting, financial technology, payments, cybersecurity, banking infrastructure and compliance.

Association, Support & Media Partners: Digital Euro Association, Fintech Latvia Association, SOEBIT Cybersecurity and 37 media partners.
Their involvement helped create opportunities for knowledge sharing, industry engagement and business networking, demonstrating the value of bringing financial institutions and technology providers together to address shared challenges and opportunities.
Paris 2027: Advancing Europe's Financial Innovation Agenda
The Paris edition will continue this commitment to connecting the financial services community, creating opportunities for organisations to showcase their solutions, exchange perspectives and build relationships across the European and international markets.
The event is designed for professionals across banking, fintech, payments, financial infrastructure, digital identity, cybersecurity, compliance, regtech and enterprise technology.
Attendees will have opportunities to engage with industry decision-makers, discover innovative solutions, contribute to discussions on emerging trends and explore potential collaborations that support business growth and technological advancement.
By bringing together established financial institutions and emerging innovators, the 6th FinTech Week & Expo aims to contribute to discussions on Europe's evolving financial ecosystem and the role of technology in building secure, efficient and accessible financial services.
A Message from Kimcy Zou
Kimcy Zou, Senior Sales Marketing at The People Events, said:
“Following the success of our previous edition in Frankfurt, which welcomed more than 400 attendees, we are excited to bring the 6th FinTech Week & Expo to Paris on 4–5 May 2027.

As artificial intelligence transforms how financial institutions operate, instant payments accelerate the movement of money, and digital trust becomes increasingly essential, collaboration across the industry is more important than ever.
“Paris offers an exciting opportunity to bring together financial institutions, fintech innovators, technology providers and industry experts from across Europe and beyond. We look forward to creating a platform where participants can exchange practical insights, showcase innovation, develop new partnerships and explore the opportunities shaping the future of European finance.”
Sponsorship, Speaking and Partnership Opportunities

title: World Launches World ID for Banking and Finance to Address AI-Driven Impersonation
summary:
At Money20/20, World co-founder Alex Blania unveiled World ID for banking and finance. Now available, the suite of technologies helps banks prevent deepfake fraud and AI-driven impersonation across customer accounts, employee workflows, and AI agents.
 
The suite of technologies brings together World ID app, World ID for Zoom, and World ID for Agents, giving banking and financial institutions greater assurance that transactions, trades, customer requests, and even important video communications are AI-safe.
 
World also announced the general availability of World ID for Zoom and that Tools for Humanity, a contributor to World, has joined Zoom’s independent software vendor (ISV) exchange program.
As AI-generated identities and impersonation techniques become more sophisticated, financial institutions face growing challenges in determining whether the individuals they interact with online are genuine. Deloitte predicts that AI-enabled fraud losses in the U.S. could reach $40 billion by 2027, up from an estimated $12.3 billion in 2023. These risks are particularly significant in banking, asset management, and other financial services, where digital interactions can involve sensitive information and consequential financial decisions.
 
World ID for banking and finance is designed to address these challenges by providing institutions with tools to establish human presence and verify relevant facts during digital interactions. The offering incorporates:
World ID app: an identity wallet that gives people a secure place to claim, manage, and present a set of AI-safe human Proofs needed to navigate the internet and digital services in the age of AI
World ID for Zoom: built for real-time communication, World ID for Zoom lets you confirm that the person you’re speaking with is human and not a deepfake
World ID for Agents: a person can establish Proofs about themselves and delegate them to an agent, allowing the agent to confirm those Proofs to a third-party platform
“As AI becomes increasingly prevalent in all aspects of our lives, enterprises are requesting individuals provide ‘Proofs’ about themselves to help mitigate fraud and increase trust,” said Sandro Herbig, president at Tools for Humanity, building technologies for World. “World ID for banking and finance offers a suite of tools to add an AI-safe trust layer across their internal and external systems.”
World is working with design partners including OpenExchange, Bain Capital, VanEck Funds, Pantera Capital, and Outtake to explore how its human infrastructure technology can support banking and financial services use cases. These collaborations demonstrate how World ID can be applied to the trust and verification challenges facing financial institutions.
 
The launch marks World's first industry-specific focus for World ID, with banking and finance selected because of the growing impact of AI-driven impersonation and the potential consequences of fraudulent interactions. By combining quantum-secure cryptographic Proof verification capabilities with tools for digital communication, World aims to help organizations establish greater confidence in the people and agents participating in sensitive interactions.

title: Case Study: How a Fintech Founder Launched an FCA-Licensed PSP Without Building Payment Infrastructure
summary:
From 2,000 to 4 million transactions a month. A fintech founder launched a payment service provider on Corefy’s white-label infrastructure, skipping at least two years of in-house development and going live two weeks after the demo.
The client
The company is an FCA-licensed payment service provider founded in 2021 by a fintech executive with more than 10 years in payments. It helps online businesses expand globally and sell locally. Merchants get local-currency payment options across regions, available through a single API integration and one dashboard.
The challenge: build or launch?
Before launch, the founder had to choose between building a payment platform from scratch and running the business on white-label infrastructure. Building in-house meant hiring a development and support team and spending years on technology before processing a single payment.
The market helped settle the decision. Several payment providers the founder planned to partner with asked whether the new PSP would integrate with Corefy, because that would make connecting with them faster. The founder then compared Corefy with another payment gateway. Corefy came out ahead on technical capabilities, tech support, and account management.
“Choosing between developing a PSP from scratch and opting for Corefy’s white-label solution, I chose the second, as it was faster and more cost-efficient.”
Founder & CEO
The solution
The PSP went from demo to first live transaction in two weeks. The setup covered:
Provider connectivity from day one. The client launched with ready-made provider integrations, so it could offer a wide range of currencies and alternative payment methods immediately. When the client needed a provider that wasn’t yet integrated, Corefy built it on request. About 20 such integrations had been delivered by the end of 2025.
Routing and cascading. The client worked with a dedicated account manager to configure routing rules for higher conversion.
Branded hosted payment page. The page carries the client’s own branding and is translated into dozens of languages, including Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, and Azerbaijani.
Operational control. One dashboard, analytics, and monthly reconciliation track income and costs per transaction and catch mismatches with provider statements.
Fraud prevention. A rule-based firewall checks each transaction against client-customised lists to reduce fraud and avoid scheme fines.
In practice: fixing a conversion leak
The account manager spotted unstable conversion in one currency on the live graphs. The cause turned out to be a single provider with recurring downtime. The team added a second provider as a failover and set cascading rules, so payments the first provider can’t process now go automatically to the second. Failed transactions dropped and conversion recovered.
Results
At least two years saved by not building an in-house development and support team
Two weeks from demo to first live transaction
About 20 new provider integrations delivered on request
Growth from about 2,000 to about 4 million transactions per month
Today the client’s team configures most of the platform independently and focuses on sales and business development, while Corefy handles infrastructure and maintenance.
“At the start of our cooperation with Corefy, the product seemed complicated. But using it now is a pleasure; I’ve learned a lot with our account manager’s help, and it’s now intuitive.”
Founder & CEO

title: Stablecoin Payments Reach $482 Billion As Token Supply Barely Grows
summary: A new payments dataset offers a useful correction to the idea that stablecoin growth must be measured by how many tokens are in circulation. The stock of digital dollars has barely moved this year, but the amount being used for payments has climbed sharply. TL;DR: Allium estimates $482 billion in identifiable stablecoin payments through September 2026, up 45% from the comparable period. Stablecoin supply grew only 0.4% to roughly $305 billion. The analytics firm’s October 15 research counted about 1.04 billion payment transactions across the first nine months, a 71% rise. That means the increase is not simply a handful of larger transfers distorting the total. More transactions are taking place, and the average payment has become smaller. The figures are filtered to reflect payment activity rather than every on-chain movement. That matters when raw stablecoin transfer totals can be dominated by exchange arbitrage, transfers between a company’s own wallets or automated trading. The $482 billion estimate is not intended to represent all stablecoin transactions. Payment companies have been connecting familiar card and banking systems to blockchain rails, reducing the need for businesses or customers to interact with crypto-specific tools. Allium’s report suggests this infrastructure is beginning to change usage patterns, even with supply essentially flat. There are limits to what the numbers prove. Volume is not profit, nor does an active token necessarily reflect durable consumer adoption. But a market where existing coins turn over more often is different from one dependent on continuous new issuance. For payment providers, that distinction is becoming increasingly important. Written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae.
content: Stablecoin payments reached $482 billion through September, marking a 45% increase compared to the previous period, despite token supply remaining nearly flat at around $305 billion. According to data from Allium, payment transactions rose 71% to over 1 billion, indicating that existing digital dollars are turning over much more frequently rather than relying on new token issuance.
content_ta: செப்டம்பர் வரை Stablecoin பேமெண்ட்டுகள் $482 பில்லியனை எட்டியுள்ளன. Token சப்ளை சுமார் $305 பில்லியனாகவே இருந்தபோதிலும், முந்தைய காலகட்டத்துடன் ஒப்பிடும்போது இது 45% வளர்ச்சியாகும். Allium தரவுகளின்படி, பேமெண்ட் பரிவர்த்தனைகள் 71% அதிகரித்து 1 பில்லியனுக்கும் அதிகமாகியுள்ளது. புதிய Tokenகளின் உருவாக்கம் இல்லாமல், ஏற்கனவே உள்ள டிஜிட்டல் டாலர்கள் அதிகளவில் புழக்கத்தில் இருப்பதை இது காட்டுகிறது.

title: Fidelity Pays $500,000 In California Crypto Withdrawal Settlement
summary: California has secured a $500,000 settlement with Fidelity Digital Asset Services over restrictions that previously prevented some crypto customers from moving purchased coins to their own wallets. TL;DR: Attorney General Rob Bonta announced the settlement on October 16. California challenged historical withdrawal restrictions; Fidelity disputes that its conduct breached state law, and transfers were enabled after a 2025 regulatory approval. The issue is a straightforward one for anyone accustomed to self-custody: buying crypto through an app is not necessarily the same as being able to withdraw it. California’s commodity rules require certain transactions to involve physical delivery within a defined period. The state’s position is that delivery of cryptocurrency requires the buyer to be able to transfer the asset away from the dealer. Fidelity told investigators that it had been waiting for permission from the New York Department of Financial Services before allowing external withdrawals. That permission arrived in April 2025, at which point the company enabled the functionality. The state says the earlier restrictions were unlawful; Fidelity disputes that conclusion. The California Department of Justice linked its investigation to an earlier case concerning Robinhood Crypto. The announcement is therefore part of a wider regulatory argument over what rights buyers should receive when crypto is sold through a conventional financial services interface. The dollar amount is relatively small for a company of Fidelity’s size. The principle is larger. Regulators are examining whether customers who pay for cryptocurrencies receive meaningful control over their holdings or only an internal account balance. Investors should still check withdrawal availability and the terms of their specific account rather than assume every Fidelity product works identically. Written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae.
content: California has reached a $500,000 settlement with Fidelity Digital Asset Services regarding restrictions that previously prevented some customers from withdrawing purchased crypto to their own wallets. The state argued that delivery requires the ability to transfer assets away from the dealer, while Fidelity noted it was waiting for regulatory approval before enabling external withdrawals. Fidelity disputed any wrongdoing, and withdrawal functionality was later enabled following regulatory approval.
content_ta: கலிபோர்னியா மாநிலத்தில் உள்ள வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் வாங்கிய crypto-வை சொந்த வாலெட்டுகளுக்கு மாற்றத் தடை விதித்த விவகாரம் தொடர்பாக, Fidelity Digital Asset Services நிறுவனம் $500,000 அபராதத் தொகையைச் செலுத்த ஒப்புக்கொண்டுள்ளது. டெலிவரி என்பது டீலரிடம் இருந்து சொத்துக்களை மாற்றுவதற்கான உரிமையை உள்ளடக்கியது என்று மாநில அரசு வாதிட்டது. அதே நேரத்தில், முறையான அனுமதி கிடைத்த பிறகே வெளிப்புறத் தொகைப் பரிமாற்றம் அனுமதிக்கப்பட்டதாக Fidelity தரப்பில் தெரிவிக்கப்பட்டது.

title: Claude Traces NIST Cryptography Seeds To An Old Random-Number Generator
summary: An unusual piece of cryptography history has gained an answer. Anthropic says Claude reconstructed how the original seed values behind several widely used NIST elliptic curves were generated, resolving a question that had attracted suspicion for more than two decades. TL;DR: Claude identified a process involving the C library’s lrand48 generator and Unix timestamps. Anthropic […]
content: Anthropic reports that its Claude AI has successfully traced the origin of seed values behind several widely used NIST elliptic curves. This discovery resolves a long-standing cryptographic question that had drawn suspicion for over twenty years. Claude determined the generation process relied on Unix timestamps and the C library’s lrand48 random-number generator, shedding light on a historical piece of digital security.
content_ta: Anthropic நிறுவனத்தின் Claude AI, NIST-ன் எம்பிக்கள் வளைவுகளுக்குப் (elliptic curves) பின்னணியில் உள்ள விதை மதிப்புகளின் மூலத்தைக் வெற்றிகரமாகக் கண்டறிந்துள்ளதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. இந்த கண்டுபிடிப்பு இரண்டு தசாப்தங்களுக்கும் மேலாக சந்தேகத்தை ஏற்படுத்தியிருந்த நீண்டகால கிரிப்டோகிராஃபிக் கேள்விக்கு தீர்வு கண்டுள்ளது. Unix timestamps மற்றும் C library-ன் lrand48 சீரற்ற எண் ஜெனரேட்டர் (random-number generator) ஆகியவற்றைப் பயன்படுத்தி இந்த உருவாக்கம் நடந்துள்ளதாக Claude கண்டறிந்துள்ளது.

title: Binance Completes 37th BNB Chain Burn: This Is How Many Tokens Were Burned
summary: BNB's 37th quarterly burn has permanently removed 1,646,196 tokens, worth about $1.197 billion, from circulation.
content: Binance has successfully completed its 37th quarterly BNB Chain token burn. This latest event permanently removed 1,646,196 BNB tokens from circulation. The total value of the burned digital assets is estimated at approximately $1.197 billion. Quarterly token burns are a key mechanism used to gradually reduce the overall circulating supply of the cryptocurrency over time.
content_ta: Binance தனது 37வது காலாண்டு BNB Chain டோக்கன் எரிப்பு நடவடிக்கையை வெற்றிகரமாக முடித்துள்ளது. இந்த சமீபத்திய நிகழ்வின் மூலம் புழக்கத்தில் இருந்த 1,646,196 BNB டோக்கன்கள் நிரந்தரமாக அகற்றப்பட்டுள்ளன. எரிக்கப்பட்ட இந்த டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துகளின் மொத்த மதிப்பு தோராயமாக $1.197 பில்லியன் ஆகும். காலப்போக்கில் கிரிப்டோகரன்சியின் ஒட்டுமொத்த புழக்கத்தை படிப்படியாகக் குறைக்க காலாண்டு டோக்கன் எரிப்புகள் ஒரு முக்கிய வழிமுறையாகப் பயன்படுத்தப்படுகின்றன.

title: Huntington Bank partners Google Cloud for AI-powered small business operating system
summary:
The Huntington National Bank today announced The 1866 Studio, a new AI-powered operating system built with Gemini platform, Google Cloud's AI platform. Named for the year Huntington was founded, The 1866 Studio honors the bank's legacy of empowering businesses by bringing together business guidance, financial intelligence, digital tools and human expertise into a single, connected experience for aspiring and existing small business owners.
The 1866 Studio is designed to simplify the complex and time-consuming demands of starting and running a business. The operating system will provide agentic AI workflows across the financial, operational and management needs of business owners that streamline complex work and help them move from information to intelligence to action. By retaining relevant business context across tasks, The 1866 Studio enables business owners to orchestrate decisions across disparate tools while maintaining control as their needs evolve.
"Small businesses are essential to strong communities and a strong economy, and helping businesses thrive has been central to Huntington's purpose for more than 160 years," said Brant Standridge, president of Huntington Bank. "We are continually looking for new ways to help business owners navigate challenges, seize opportunities and spend more time focused on the financial success and growth of their businesses. The 1866 Studio is the next evolution of that commitment, bringing together Huntington's expertise and Gemini platform to help owners make more informed decisions and spend more time building the businesses they imagined."
The 1866 Studio will leverage Huntington's extensive small business and financial expertise and an AI-powered experience built using Google Cloud's comprehensive platform to build, scale, govern and optimize agents. Combined with Google's multimodal Gemini models, Gemini platform is enabling Huntington to offer business owners an intelligent, connected operating system that helps them navigate decisions with greater confidence and efficiency.
"Small business owners shouldn't have to become experts in every function or in AI to build a successful business," said Vijay Konduru, head of innovation and AI products at Huntington. "The 1866 Studio is an AI-powered platform designed around the small business jobs to be done. As the product evolves, it's intended to increasingly support the full range of those jobs across the business lifecycle, from turning an idea into a business to running and growing it, and ultimately preparing for succession, sale or exit."
"The future of small business banking is about delivering expertise and guidance in the moments customers need it most," said Rohit Bhat, general manager and managing director, Financial Services, Google Cloud. "By using Gemini platform and Gemini frontier models to build The 1866 Studio, Huntington is creating an innovative experience that helps small business owners move from information to action."
Initial AI capabilities of The 1866 Studio, including agentic workflows, equip entrepreneurs to turn business ideas into actionable plans, navigate startup requirements, strengthen their brand, identify funding sources, enable funding readiness and plan for growth. For example:
Business launch support: With built-in AI agents, owners can navigate the steps required to start a business, from entity selection and registration to licensing and operational setup, while generating a customized action plan to help move from idea to launch.
Marketing & campaign creation: Leveraging multimodal Gemini models, owners can instantly generate tailored marketing collateral, digital ad copy and social media campaigns.
Loan readiness assistance: AI-powered agents help owners evaluate financing readiness by identifying potential gaps, explaining lender expectations and recommending actions that can strengthen eligibility for future financing opportunities.
"Agentic AI workflows that help carry out tasks are one part of this end-to-end operating system," Konduru added. "Alongside them are relevant, personalized expert content and an AI assistant that helps owners both monitor their business operations and finances and manage and orchestrate daily work. Together, these capabilities help owners move from advice to action with support that evolves with the business, while they remain in control."
The 1866 Studio builds on Huntington's multi-year strategic partnership with Google Cloud to modernize technology, advance governed AI capabilities and accelerate innovation. Through the partnership, Huntington continues to explore new ways to use technology built with Google Cloud to enhance experiences for customers, colleagues and the communities and businesses it serves.
Interested small business owners and entrepreneurs, not limited to Huntington customers, can sign up for early access to The 1866 Studio beginning Oct. 19.

title: Jack Henry Expands Collaboration With Google Cloud to Deliver Tokenized Deposits for Banks and Credit Unions
summary:
Jack Henry® today announced an expansion of its collaboration with Google Cloud designed to pave the way for banks and credit unions to offer tokenized deposits through Google Cloud Universal Ledger (GCUL). As part of the expanding relationship, Jack Henry will become the first core technology provider to integrate with GCUL, helping financial institutions modernize deposit offerings, strengthen accountholder relationships, and introduce new payment and settlement capabilities. GCUL is a fully managed, distributed ledger service that enables financial institutions to tokenize and transfer money and assets on a shared, real-time record with programmable, 24/7 settlement capabilities.
As consumer and business expectations continue to evolve toward real-time, programmable, and seamless financial experiences, community and regional financial institutions face growing competition from large banks and fintech providers. By integrating tokenized deposit infrastructure into Jack Henry's ecosystem, banks and credit unions can explore new transactional use cases, enhance digital experiences, and position themselves to meet emerging market demands.
"Tokenized deposits have the potential to reshape how money moves across the financial ecosystem," said Jack Henry Chief Technology Officer Ben Metz. "Our strategy is centered on helping financial institutions navigate emerging technologies and access innovative capabilities through trusted, scalable infrastructure. By expanding our work with Google Cloud and serving as the first core technology provider to use GCUL, we're helping community banks and credit unions explore new opportunities while building on the relationships, service, and expertise that have always set them apart."
Jack Henry and Google Cloud established their strategic relationship in 2022 to accelerate Jack Henry's cloud-native technology modernization strategy. Last June, the companies announced plans to deliver AI-driven security capabilities, integrating Google Cloud's agentic defense solutions to protect banks and credit unions against increasingly sophisticated cyber threats. The integration with GCUL combines modern ledger technology with secure, scalable cloud infrastructure to help financial institutions explore new digital asset and payment capabilities.
"Financial innovation should be accessible to institutions of all sizes," said James Tromans, director, Web3 and Digital Assets at Google Cloud. "Google Cloud Universal Ledger provides a secure and scalable foundation for programmable value exchange. Through our collaboration with Jack Henry, we are bringing advanced digital asset capabilities to community and regional financial institutions, helping them build on the relationships and trust they have established with their customers."

title: Finastra Launches Cloud-Enabled SBLC Solution to Help U.S. Banks Digitize Standby Letter of Credit Processing
summary:
Today at Money 20/20 in Las Vegas, Finastra announced Finastra StandbyX, a cloud-enabled solution designed to help U.S. banks digitize and automate standby letter of credit (SBLC) processing while strengthening risk management and operational efficiency.
 
SBLCs remain a widely used instrument across both trade and non-trade transactions in the U.S. While larger institutions typically manage SBLCs, alongside broader trade finance operations on platforms such as Trade Innovation, many regional and mid-sized banks continue to rely on manual or semi-manual processes. This can create operational inefficiencies, increase risk, and limit scalability.
 
Purpose-built for SBLCs, Finastra StandbyX provides a streamlined SaaS deployment model that enables banks to modernize their operations without implementing a full trade finance platform. Designed for rapid implementation, the solution minimizes integration requirements and testing effort while offering a competitive total cost of ownership.
 
The launch forms part of Finastra’s ongoing investment in its trade solutions portfolio, helping financial institutions modernize operations, improve efficiency, unlock new growth opportunities, and deliver better customer and user experiences.
 
How Finastra StandbyX helps banks in the U.S.
 


Provides proven standby letter of credit capabilities, through the SBLC module of Finastra’s Trade Innovation platform, which is trusted by more than 150 banks globally, helping institutions digitize operations, support growth, and strengthen risk management.
Offers a SaaS deployment model that enables banks with low to moderate transaction volumes to implement quickly and begin realizing value sooner.
Reduces operational complexity through streamlined integration and testing requirements.
It is backed by Finastra’s decades of experience supporting mission-critical banking systems for financial institutions worldwide.
Expert perspective: Digital trade for more banks
 

“Many U.S. banks have traditionally managed standby letters of credit through manual processes or workarounds," said Vinay Mendonca, Head of Trade and Supply Chain Finance and Corporate Channels at Finastra. While transaction volumes may be relatively low, the value of these instruments is often significant, making effective risk management essential. Finastra StandbyX gives banks access to proven SaaS technology that digitizes SBLC processing without the need to deploy a full trade finance platform. By making trade finance technology more accessible, we are helping a broader range of institutions improve operational efficiency, strengthen controls, and deliver a better customer experience. This is an exciting step in the evolution of our trade proposition."
 
Finastra StandbyX builds on the proven capabilities of Trade Innovation, Finastra’s trade finance platform that helps financial institutions automate workflows, manage risk, and improve operational efficiency. As part of Finastra's strategy to deliver modular, cloud-enabled and API-first solutions, StandbyX extends access to digital trade functionality for a wider range of banks.

title: Fission Raises $10M Series A Led by Pantera Capital to Bring Liquidity to Digital Private Markets
summary:
Fission, a blockchain-enabled financial technology company building liquidity infrastructure for tokenized investment funds, today announced it has closed a $10 million Series A funding round led by Pantera Capital and backed by a group of investors spanning traditional finance and digital assets.
Investment funds are rapidly moving on-chain. Tokenization has already transformed how fund interests can be issued, distributed and settled, but much of the underlying market structure remains unchanged. Tokenized funds still rely on periodic redemption windows, limited secondary liquidity and restrictive financing structures.
Fission is building the liquidity layer designed to change that.
The company enables investor liquidity for supported tokenized fund products, allowing eligible holders to access capital without waiting for traditional fund redemption cycles. Fission supports a growing universe of tokenized funds across asset classes including private credit, alternatives and other institutional investment products. The company has already processed millions of dollars in transactions and is expanding its capacity through both traditional and on-chain sources of capital.
"Putting funds on-chain is only the beginning," said Jonathan Shaffer, Founder and CEO of Fission. "The real promise of tokenization is creating fundamentally better markets around these assets: broader distribution, continuous liquidity and the ability to use fund interests as collateral in lending markets. Whether a fund is private or simply constrained by traditional liquidity structures, Fission is building the technology that makes those assets more liquid, transferable and useful across financial markets."
Fission's platform is purpose-built for institutional and permissioned markets, with infrastructure designed around the investor eligibility, transfer restrictions and compliance requirements governing regulated investment products. This allows Fission to bring on-chain liquidity to these assets while preserving the controls required by securities markets.
The new capital will support Fission's continued expansion across asset coverage, liquidity capacity and institutional integrations.
"Investment funds are moving onto digital rails and liquidity is one of the critical pieces required for that transition to reach its full potential," said Franklin Bi, General Partner at Pantera Capital. "Fission is building infrastructure that will help transform tokenized funds from representations of traditional products with legacy constraints into fundamentally more liquid and productive assets."
The round adds Pantera Capital, Circle Ventures, Borderless Capital and Ari Rubenstein to Fission's investor base, alongside existing backers including New Form, gumi Cryptos Capital, Anthony Scaramucci, Manhattan Venture Partners, Reflexive Capital and Lattice Capital.

title: Santander Builds AI Capabilities That Improve Performance and Lower Costs Using NVIDIA AI Infrastructure
summary:
Banco Santander today announced a new milestone in their artificial intelligence collaboration with NVIDIA. With support from NVIDIA, the Santander AI Lab has developed new capabilities to evaluate AI models and agents for banking applications, helping identify which model is best suited for each task and deploy it in the most efficient way.
The work is being carried out through Santander AI Lab, which explores and tests emerging AI technologies before broader deployment across the bank. As part of this effort, Santander has been progressively moving from large general-purpose models towards smaller, specialised models designed for specific banking tasks. In selected experimental use cases, this approach has reduced serving costs from around €5 per interaction to approximately €0.03 while maintaining strong performance.
Through the Lab, Santander has built Model Arena to evaluate open-weight models against banking tasks and identify the right model for each workload, and is specialising models using NVIDIA NeMo Customizer. Customer-service comparisons delivered evidence that smaller, specialised models can deliver strong performance on targeted banking tasks. Santander has built specialised intelligence for core banking workloads on NVIDIA Kumo, a family of open-weight foundation models for structured data, allowing companies to quickly turn structured data into predictive insights needed for agentic services.
The Lab is industrialising inference within Santander’s own architecture using NVIDIA Dynamo-Triton, the approach behind the serving-cost reduction above,  and is developing Model Arena to design, simulate, evaluate and supervise banking agents, alongside performance engineering and adversarial testing of conversational AI in controlled environments. The goal is to establish a rigorous experimentation path through which emerging AI technologies are optimised and stress-tested against banking requirements before successful capabilities scale across Santander.
Building on these advances, Santander is progressing from open-weight models towards specialised models and governed banking agents designed for greater control, safety and lower operating costs at scale. The collaboration is already delivering measurable results: in an experimental customer-service use case, Santander improved conversation quality while reducing costs by more than 50% through the deployment of a more efficient AI model.
As part of the next phase of the initiative, Santander and NVIDIA have established a three-year collaboration framework covering areas such as foundation models, AI agents, fraud and anti-money laundering capabilities, real-time decisioning and advanced simulation technologies, including a banking digital twin.
Iñaki Bernal, chief artificial intelligence officer at Santander, said: "NVIDIA is a key player in the infrastructure, software and research that is powering the latest advances in artificial intelligence. Combined with Santander's scale across businesses, customers and geographies, we believe we are uniquely positioned to succeed in transforming those advances into practical banking capabilities."
Aser Blanco, Global Banking Lead at NVIDIA, said: “Banking is one of the most data-centric industries. Data sits at the heart of every process and now banks need to become intelligence-centric. Transforming years of data into usable and proprietary intelligence is not about model size, but about training and fine tuning. In this new world, cost per intelligence output is a key metric. Santander is showing what that looks like in production with smaller models, specialised on the bank’s own data, evaluated against real banking tasks and served efficiently enough to run at the scale of a global bank.”
NoYesArtificial Intelligence19 Oct, 2026
content: Banco Santander has announced new AI capabilities developed in collaboration with NVIDIA through the Santander AI Lab. By transitioning from general-purpose models to smaller, specialised models using NVIDIA infrastructure and software, the bank has significantly reduced operating costs while maintaining strong performance for banking applications. The companies have also established a three-year collaboration framework to further advance AI agents, fraud detection, and real-time decisioning technologies.
content_ta: Banco Santander மற்றும் NVIDIA இணைந்து உருவாக்கிய புதிய AI திறன்களை Santander AI Lab அறிவித்துள்ளது. NVIDIA இன் உள்கட்டமைப்பு மற்றும் மென்பொருளைப் பயன்படுத்தி, பொதுவான மாடல்களில் இருந்து சிறிய மற்றும் பிரத்யேக மாடல்களுக்கு மாறுவதன் மூலம், வங்கி செயல்பாட்டுச் செலவுகளைக் கணிசமாகக் குறைத்துள்ளது. மேலும், AI ஏஜெண்டுகள் மற்றும் மோசடி கண்டறிதல் தொழில்நுட்பங்களை மேம்படுத்த இந்த நிறுவனங்கள் மூன்று ஆண்டு கூட்டுறவை எட்டியுள்ளன.

title: U.S. CFTC rebuffs CME legal stance in consequential fight over perpetual futures
summary: The future of perps in the U.S. may be at stake as the CFTC argues that CME hasn't shown the new policy is hurting it after the agency OK'd its first bitcoin perp.
content: The U.S. CFTC has pushed back against CME's legal position in a significant dispute concerning perpetual futures. The regulatory agency argued that CME failed to demonstrate that the new policy is causing it harm, following the approval of the first Bitcoin perpetual futures. This ongoing legal battle could have major implications for the future availability of perpetual futures products within the United States.
content_ta: U.S. CFTC-யானது perpetual futures தொடர்பான முக்கியமான சட்டப் போராட்டத்தில் CME-யின் சட்ட நிலைப்பாட்டை எதிர்த்துள்ளது. முதல் Bitcoin perp அனுமதிக்கப்பட்டதைத் தொடர்ந்து, புதிய கொள்கை தனக்கு எத்தகைய தீங்கையும் விளைவிக்கவில்லை என்பதை CME நிரூபிக்கவில்லை என்று ஒழுங்குமுறை நிறுவனம் வாதிட்டுள்ளது. இந்தச் சட்டப் போராட்டம் United States-ல் perpetual futures-ன் எதிர்காலத்தைப் பாதிக்கலாம்.

title: Bitcoin is rejected at $83K as US bond yields reverse higher with equities
summary: Bitcoin price action failed to improve with equities as a sell wall at $83,000 kept BTC in a tight range.
content: Bitcoin faced a rejection near the $83,000 level as its price action struggled to keep pace with equities. A strong sell wall at $83,000 kept the cryptocurrency trapped in a tight trading range. Meanwhile, United States bond yields reversed their trend and moved higher alongside the broader stock market, putting additional pressure on digital assets.
content_ta: Bitcoin விலை $83,000 என்ற மதிப்பைத் தாண்டிச் செல்ல முடியாமல் சரிவைக் சந்தித்தது. பங்குச் சந்தை உயர்வுக்கு ஏற்ப Bitcoin விலை உயரவில்லை. $83,000 அளவில் இருந்த விற்பனை அழுத்தம் காரணமாக இந்த Cryptocurrency ஒரு குறுகிய எல்லைக்குள் வர்த்தகமானது. இதற்கிடையில், United States பத்திரங்களின் வட்டி விகிதங்கள் உயர்ந்ததுடன் பங்குச் சந்தையும் ஏற்றம் கண்டது.

title: Abandoned Bitcoin? Wallet Targeted by Noah Doe Lawsuit Moves $33 Million
summary: A Bitcoin address dormant since 2013 moved 411.45 BTC worth about $33.4 million, according to Galaxy Research, and it’s among the wallets named in the “Noah Doe” lawsuit.
content: A Bitcoin wallet dormant since 2013 has moved 411.45 BTC valued at approximately $33.4 million. According to Galaxy Research, this address is among those targeted in the ongoing Noah Doe lawsuit. The sudden movement of these long-inactive funds has drawn attention from industry analysts monitoring the case and associated wallet activity.

Galaxy Research-இன் படி, Noah Doe வழக்கின் மூலம் குறிவைக்கப்பட்ட வாலட்களில் இந்த முகவரியும் ஒன்றாகும். நீண்ட காலமாக செயலற்ற நிலையில் இருந்த இந்த நிதியின் திடீர் நகர்வு, வழக்கை கண்காணிக்கும் துறை சார்ந்த ஆய்வாளர்களின் கவனத்தை ஈர்த்துள்ளது.
